post.description: Interactive owner/admin creates a key for self. Secret returned once; duplicate key ID conflicts. Nonempty unique data scopes, maximum four; future expiry at most 90 days.

AccessToken.bearerFormat: RS256 access JWT or kk1 API key
AccessToken.description: Interactive JWT required for control-plane operations. kk1 keys can use only their delegated data-plane scopes in their bound tenant. JWT signing keys use trusted file configuration or bounded HTTPS discovery; expired key trust fails closed. Full browser login and sessions remain pending.
